obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Account balance must be non-negative prior to any withdrawal operation
assumptions.justification: Standard financial account invariant; balances are initialized non-negative and no prior operation should leave balance negative

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be a non-negative integer; negative amounts would represent a deposit and are outside the contract of this function
assumptions.justification: API schema for withdrawal endpoint requires amount to be a positive value; passing a negative amount is rejected at ingress
